messages:
Priya Narang: Quick sync — running a compressed QBR for AtlasCorp next Tue. Need exec slide + onboarding gate status. Agenda: exec asks, onboarding gaps, renewal risk + mitigations, action owners. Link: https://tiny.redwood/qbr-atlascorp

Alex Chen: Can someone upload latest usage chart and latency SLA chart? I’ll add cost delta slide.

Priya Narang: @Alex I uploaded chart_v3 in the doc (slides 4-5). Also need canonical renewal score & top-3 churn signals.

Maya Ortiz: Renewal risk = amber. Two onboarding gates blocking: SSO claim mapping + dedicated routing test. Low active seats last 30d. Recommend 1-week enablement sprint + SE-led routing verification. :warning:

Jonah Blake: Exec invites sent — VP Eng and Head of Platform included. Need a single-slide "asks for exec" (clear approvals). @Priya can you draft the asks?

Carmen Li: I can run the enablement sprint. Propose this scope: onboarding checklist, live demo, post-demo playbook.

Priya Narang: Action items — copying into thread so we have traceability:
```
- Carmen: enablement sprint plan (due Fri EOD)
- Alex: cost & latency slides (due Thu noon)
- Maya: SSO + routing test status update (due Thu 5pm)
- Jonah: Exec deck + invite confirm (done)
- Priya: capture customer feedback + QBR script (due Mon)
```

Alex Chen: I'll add a short appendix slide showing expected cost delta if they enable cache/batching. Will drop numbers by EOD.

Maya Ortiz: Update on SSO: Atlas infra needs claim mapping change; engineering contact assigned, ETA Thu EOD. Routing smoke test scheduled Fri 09:30 on staging.

ops-bot: Reminder set: @Carmen to run enablement sprint kickoff on 2025-02-14 10:00.

Alex Chen: Added a small table to the doc with 30/60/90 day impact estimates. Will highlight assumptions.

Priya Narang: Quick ask — everyone please add a 1-line "ask for exec" in the doc under slide 2 by EOD today. Keeps the narrative tight. :pray:

Jonah Blake: Added my line: "Approval for 6-week dedicated pilot + SLA amendment." :white_check_mark:

Carmen Li: Added mine: "Approve enablement credits + SE time for sprint."

Priya Narang: Thanks all. Dry run scheduled Mon 09:30 (20 min). I'll post calendar invite and share runbook.

Alex Chen: :thumbsup: I'll be on the run.

Maya Ortiz: Will bring the gating checklist to the dry run.

Carmen Li: On it.
